triggers.name: new_event
triggers.title: Updated record
triggers.help: Triggers whenever a previously enriched contact or company is updated in ZoomInfo. You'll only get update notification within 365 days of when you enriched this contact/company in ZoomInfo.

input.name: record_type
input.label: Object
input.hint: Select Record type to trigger in real-time.

actions.name: __adhoc_http_action
actions.title: Custom action
actions.help: Build your own ZoomInfo action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized with your ZoomInfo connection.

input.name: mnemonic
input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.name: enrich_company
actions.title: Enrich companies
actions.help: Use this action to match company information based on input values and return the desired output fields in the response. You can input a maximum of 25 companies in a single enrich request, returning the equivalent number of matching records. Specify atleast one field to search.

actions.name: enrich_contact
actions.title: Enrich contacts
actions.help: Use this action to match contact information based on input values and return the desired output fields in the response. actions.name: retrieve_comp_location
actions.title: Enrich company location
actions.help: Use this action to find the location details of a given company ID. Use the Search companies or Enrich companies actions to get company IDs.

actions.name: retrieve_compliance
actions.title: Enrich compliance data
actions.help: Returns a list of compliance-related details from ZoomInfo's data which meet the specified search criteria. actions.name: retrieve_corporate_hierarchy
actions.title: Enrich corporate hierarchy
actions.help: Use this action to find the corporate hierarchy of a given company ID. Use the Search companies or Enrich companies actions to get company IDs.

actions.name: retrieve_hashtag
actions.title: Enrich hashtags
actions.help: Use this action to retrieve the hashtags that are used to refer to this company.

actions.name: retrieve_org_chart
actions.title: Enrich organizational chart
actions.help: Use this action to retrieve organisation chart details based on a given company and department.

actions.name: retrieve_scoops
actions.title: Enrich scoops

actions.name: retrieve_technology
actions.title: Enrich technology stack information
actions.help: Use this action to retrieve information about the current technology used in a given company.

actions.name: search_companies
actions.title: Search companies
actions.help: Returns a list of Companies from ZoomInfo's data which meet the specified search criteria. Specify at least one field to search. Contacts searched do not count towards your ZoomInfo credits until you enrich them.

actions.name: search_contacts
actions.title: Search contacts
actions.help: Returns a list of contacts from ZoomInfo's data which meet the specified search criteria. Specify atleast one field to search.

actions.name: search_intent
actions.title: Search intent
actions.help: Returns a list of intent records from ZoomInfo's data which meet the specified search criteria. Use this action to search for companies and recommended contacts based on intent data. Specify atleast one field to search.

actions.name: search_news
actions.title: Search news
actions.help: Returns a list of news articles from ZoomInfo's data which meet the specified search criteria. All inputs are optional, but you must use at least one input parameter to generate a successful response.

actions.name: search_scoops
actions.title: Search scoops
actions.help: Returns a list of scoops from ZoomInfo's data which meet the specified search criteria. Specify atleast one field to search.
